$comment: Merged only when `setup.sh install --advisor` is passed. Opt-in for three reasons stated in the
official docs: the tool is experimental, it is Anthropic-API-only (not Bedrock, AWS, GCP, or
Foundry), and it costs additional tokens at the advisor model's rates.
Subagents inherit it, so da-review-all's per-layer subagents get the same advisor.
Turn it off with /advisor off, or CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ADVISOR_TOOL=1 to disable the tool itself.
